references.sentence: The block diagram of the synthesizer is shown in Fig. 5.5.1.
The VCO topology consists of complementary NMOS and PMOS devices, as shown in Fig. 5.5.2.
The high-frequency divide-by-2 circuit, shown in Fig. 5.5.3, consists of two current-mode flip-flops in a feedback loop, clocked by the VCO.
Although individual inductors are used in our implementation as shown in Fig. 5.5.3, a single inductor with multiple taps would provide similar benefits and a more compact layout.
Shown in Fig. 5.5.4 is the simplified schematic of the CP.
The measured phase noise profile at the output of the 802.11a transmitter, at a 5240MHz carrier frequency, using a reference frequency of 13.3MHz is shown in Fig. 5.5.5.
The performance is summarized in the table of Fig. 5.5.6.
The micrograph of the synthesizer is shown in Fig. 5.5.7.
